title: Las isletas
goal: Haggle a boat around the isletas
culture: Per person is the tourist unit. Ask for the boat rather than the seat and the number changes, and settle the return before you push off — the same lesson the fisherman in Pantanal taught you, at Malecón prices.

beats.good: Una vuelta is a spin, a lap, a trip round. It is the word for this and it costs less than the thing called a tour.
The same islands the fisherman took you to, at the price the Malecón charges. Which is why this mission is a haggle and that one was not.

beats.objective: Ask for the boat, not the seat
beats.en: And how much for all of us?
beats.good: Per person is the tourist unit. Ask for the whole boat and the arithmetic changes in your favour immediately.

beats.es: Cuarenta por todos y los traigo de vuelta.
beats.good: You learned this from the fisherman. Ask it again anyway — a boat is the one place where the return really is negotiable.
